description.value: Napoletana Pizza Restaurant has been serving hand-stretched Neapolitan pizza and fresh daily pasta on Fraser Street in Vancouver since 2002. With indoor and outdoor seating, table reservations, and a curated Italian wine and cocktail list, it offers a full sit-down dining experience alongside pickup and delivery. Operating for over two decades, it is a well-established neighbourhood destination for authentic Italian cuisine.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pizzanapoletana.ca is live and documents a real, operating Italian restaurant, but there is a critical address discrepancy: OSM places it at 1210 Robson Street while the website consistently and clearly states 3875 Fraser Street, Vancouver, BC V5V 4E3 — the website's address is used as authoritative per rule 12. Takeout via pickup and delivery is explicitly confirmed on the website; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. The OSM name 'Napoletana Pizza' is retained per policy, but the website uses the fuller name 'Napoletana Pizza Restaurant' throughout all pages.
concerns: Critical address mismatch: OSM lists 1210 Robson Street but the website clearly and consistently states 3875 Fraser Street, Vancouver, BC V5V 4E3. The OSM node may be misplaced or may represent an older or different location. Website address used as authoritative.
